versions.changelog:
- Initial release of jd-truth-detector.
- Analyze job descriptions across four dimensions: jargon translation, company culture inference, resume matching, and negotiation signals.
- Outputs results as Markdown and shareable HTML reports.
- Supports input via direct text paste, URL scraping (BOSS, 拉勾, LinkedIn), and files (.txt, .md, .docx, .pdf).
- Compatible with any OpenAI-compatible LLM; easily configurable for local or cloud endpoints.
- Ensures privacy: data sent only to your selected LLM endpoint, with no telemetry.
